source.title: Fine Structures of Berry Curvature and Unquantized Valley Chern Numbers in Valley Photonic Crystals
source.parameter_evolution_figure: Figure 2 panels b-c and Figure 3 panels d-i

source_parameter_definition.name: f_r
source_parameter_definition.r_cir_meaning: radius of the circular arcs replacing the three triangle corners
source_parameter_definition.r_tri_meaning: nominal circumradius of the equilateral triangular construction before uniform area normalization
source_parameter_definition.source_statement_near_zero: For f_r below approximately 0.19, the second-band at-K Berry curvature remains positive.
source_parameter_definition.intermediate_source_anchor_policy: Do not invent intermediate values; the approximate 0.19 statement is not frozen as a direct distribution-comparison value.

geometry_construction.public_space: Cartesian physical geometry is defined first.
geometry_construction.base_shape: Accepted E9A regular equilateral triangle with one vertex at positive y.
geometry_construction.corner_replacement: Each vertex is replaced by a circular arc tangent to both adjacent sides.
geometry_construction.arc_center_rule: For nominal triangle circumradius R and arc radius rho, each arc center is displaced 2*rho inward along the vertex bisector.
geometry_construction.tangent_offset_rule: Each tangent point is sqrt(3)*rho from its vertex along the adjacent side.
geometry_construction.maximum_rounding_rule: At f_r=0.5 the tangent segments vanish and the three arcs share the triangle center, forming one circle.
geometry_construction.constant_area_rule: Uniformly scale the nominal rounded construction so its analytic area equals the accepted fr=0 triangle area.
geometry_construction.c3_rule: Three identical corners and 120-degree rotational repetition.
geometry_construction.join_rule: Line-to-arc joins are tangent; no corner polygon approximation is used as the public geometry.
geometry_construction.self_intersection_rule: The allowed interval and tangent offset bound are checked analytically and with a sampled boundary intersection audit.

coordinate_adapter.mpb_use: Self-check only; no MPB object or solver is allowed in E9E.A.
